item.title: Who is Rupert Murdoch? Media giant sued by Trump over WSJ's Epstein letter; MAGA chief calls paper ‘pile of garbage’ after row
item.description: Donald Trump has sued Rupert Murdoch's News Corp over a Wall Street Journal report detailing a 2003 birthday letter allegedly written by Trump to Jeffrey Epstein. The letter, found in a birthday album organized by Ghislaine Maxwell, contains suggestive content. Trump denies writing the message, claiming defamation and political motivation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Little group fading fast’: Donald Trump mocks Brics; reiterates 10% tariff threat to protect US dollar dominance
item.description: Donald Trump dismissed the Brics group as fading and threatened tariffs on nations aligning with its policies, claiming credit for weakening their efforts to rival the US dollar. He signed the GENIUS Act into law, establishing a regulatory framework for payment stablecoins and preventing a US central bank digital currency. Brics denies being anti-American, despite Trump's claims.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Prayed for this day’: 10 Americans freed from Venezuelan prison in prisoner exchange programme; El Salvador releases over 200 Venezuelans
item.description: Ten Americans are coming back home after a prisoner swap. The US, El Salvador, and Venezuela are involved. More than 200 Venezuelan migrants are leaving El Salvador for Venezuela. These migrants were earlier deported by the Trump administration. They were held in a mega-prison. The exchange also involves the release of Venezuelan political prisoners.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: Power Slap set to return to Abu Dhabi in a highly anticipated event on October, 2025
item.description: Power Slap, the world’s leading slap-fighting promotion, is returning to Abu Dhabi on October 24, 2025, following a highly successful inaugural international event in the city last year. As part of Abu Dhabi Showdown Week alongside UFC 321, the event highlights the UAE’s growing role as a global combat sports hub, offering free live streaming worldwide on YouTube and Rumble.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Out of touch’: Mamdani's old prison remarks resurface; law enforcement slams NYC hopeful
item.description: New York mayoral front-runner Zohran Mamdani's past remarks questioning the purpose of jails and prisons have ignited controversy. Law enforcement officials criticized his views as out of touch and potentially dangerous for communities. Mamdani's stance, highlighted in a resurfaced clip, has drawn sharp rebuke, especially from GOP candidate Curtis Sliwa, setting the stage for a contentious election.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Indian man seeks asylum in Canada, claims 'murder framing' in Haryana; 200 others told the same story
item.description: Parwinder Singh, seeking refuge in Canada, claims he's framed for a friend's murder in Haryana, a story echoed by 200 others using the same immigration consultant. Despite fraud claims by Canada's Refugee Appeal Division (RAD), Justice Régimbald noted asylum narratives aren't creative writing contests and hence Singh's plea will be reviewed. Singh says he fled India after police harassment following a brawl where a boy was killed.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: H-1B cap limit for 2026 already reached: What does this mean for Indians?
item.description: USCIS has reached the H-1B visa cap for fiscal year 2026, halting new cap-subject petitions. The agency will continue processing cap-exempt petitions, including those for current H-1B workers retaining their cap numbers. The next registration for FY 2027 will commence in March 2026, while extensions and changes for existing H-1B workers remain unaffected.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Unruly behaviour’: Detroit-bound Delta Airlines flight diverted as passenger tries to open door mid-air; fights with attendant
item.description: A Delta Airlines flight from Omaha to Detroit made an emergency landing in Iowa. A passenger, Mario Nikprelaj, fought with a flight attendant. He also tried to open an exit door mid-air. The pilot requested an emergency landing. Nikprelaj was arrested after landing. He faces charges including assault and harassment. The flight later continued to Detroit.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Astronomer announces investigation into CEO Andy Byron's 'extramarital affair', claims there was no other employee in viral Coldplay video
item.description: Astronomer is launching a formal investigation following CEO Andy Byron's viral video at a Coldplay concert, where he was allegedly caught in a compromising situation with HR personnel Kristin Cabot. Social media users speculated about the involvement of employee Alyssa Stoddard, who was present at the event but the company now said no other employee was there.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Luggage covered in poop? Virgin Atlantic says it did not come from plane, it's not human excrement
item.description: Virgin Atlantic refuted claims that passenger baggage arriving at JFK was soiled with human waste after social media posts went viral. The airline said it was not human poop and it did not come from the plane. The airline said the substance was grease from a broken pipe in the terminal.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai now in London: Emirate opens first international hub to facilitate investor access
item.description: Dubai Chambers has launched Dubai Hub London, its first international center, to facilitate access to Dubai’s government and private sector services for UK-based investors and businesses. Operated by Al Burj Holding, the hub offers support across real estate, legal, and business setup processes, aiming to streamline cross-border transactions and strengthen economic ties between the UAE and the UK.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Supreme humiliation’: Former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro ordered to wear ankle monitor; ‘concrete possibility’ of him fleeing, says SC
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro, ex-president of Brazil, must wear an ankle monitor. The Supreme Court issued the order. Raids occurred at his home and party headquarters. He faces restrictions on movement and communication. Bolsonaro is accused of plotting to overturn the 2022 election. Donald Trump called it a witch hunt. He plans tariffs on Brazilian imports.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Katie Miller speaks up on her relationship with Elon Musk: 'My paycheck still comes from him'
item.description: ​Katie walked out of the White House with Elon Musk, triggering a rumor storm that they had an affair and she would be divorcing Stephen Miller, Trump's aide. All three of them were very close during the initial days of Musk's Washington phase as they used to spend time together even outside work.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Startling revelation in American Idol exec's murder: Robin Kaye, husband dead for 4 days, cops didn't enter house
item.description: American Idol executive Robin Kaye and her husband, Thomas Deluca, were found dead in their Los Angeles home, victims of a suspected burglary gone wrong. Police, responding to an earlier burglary complaint, hadn't entered the property initially. Raymond Boodarian, 22, is now charged with their murders and residential burglary. Kaye had previously voiced concerns about neighborhood burglaries.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Don't care how many people Barack Obama deported: Viral clash between Piers Morgan and Joy Reid
item.description: Piers Morgan and Joy Reid engaged in a heated debate on Morgan's show, clips of which have gone viral. Reid accused Morgan of ambushing her and exploiting race for his audience. The discussion centered on deportation policies of both Obama and Trump, with Morgan questioning Reid's outrage over Trump's actions compared to Obama's.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Texas highway crash: 4 killed, 18 injured in San Antonio; armed suspect still at large
item.description: A tragic high-speed collision in San Antonio, Texas, resulted in four fatalities and eighteen hospitalizations. A stolen Camaro, speeding on Interstate 35, crashed into a transport bus towing a trailer. San Antonio police chief Bill McManus reported that four suspects fled the scene, at least one armed with an assault rifle.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Bollywood-style performances': Indian couple in Texas accused of multimillion-dollar fraud. Who are Sammy and Sunita Mukherjee?
item.description: Indian couple Sammy and Sunita Mukherjee has been accused of multimillion dollar scam in Texas. They used to host Bollywood-style galas and parties where they used to perform only to convince people to invest in their real estate projects that did not exist. Sammy Mukherjee denied the allegations and said people are jealous of his success.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Can online comments be considered crime in UAE? Woman fined AED 30,000 for offensive messages
item.description: A woman in Abu Dhabi was ordered to pay Dh30,000 in moral damages after sending abusive messages and comments via social media. The civil ruling followed a criminal conviction and highlights how UAE law treats online defamation with heightened seriousness due to its viral reach, permanence, and reputational impact, even in private messages or comment sections.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Astronomer CEO Andy Byron's 4-word reaction of shock after seeing his face on Coldplay kiss cam
item.description: ​Astronomer CEO Andy Byron was shocked when the Coldplay jumbotron panned on him and Kristin Cabot and uttered four words, according to reports. Dropping the F bomb, he said, "F**king hell, it's me," and ducked the camera while Cabot hid her face and said: "This is awkward". These are the only reactions obtained from them so far as the extra-marital affair scandal ballooned into a bigger controversy over workplace ethics.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Random Musing: Is the new Superman movie ‘anti-Israel’? Depends on your 'extrapolation bias'
item.description: The Extrapolation Bias: A meta-bias where one’s brain takes one bit of data and decides to use it explain everything. It’s the Captain Planet of cognitive distortions – summoned when Confirmation Bias, Availability Heuristic, the Baader-Meinhof Effect, Illusory Correlation and Narrative Bias join forces. It’s the mind’s lazy cognitive shortcut where one instance becomes an example of a pattern and ergo proof of how society is functioning. You're not analysing — you're projecting, pattern-hunting, and storytelling your way into a worldview that feels right, even if it has no resemblance to reality.
item.dc:creator: Nirmalya Dutta
